provenance: Digests of the resource grids that MATLAB R2026a (5G Toolbox 26.1, NR-FR1 test-model configurations of the 5G Waveform Generator app helper, PN23 data) produced for the listed configurations, and that opendpd.core.waveforms.nr_tm.grid reproduces with data_convention='matlab'. Only hashes of numerical output are stored; no MathWorks code or data files are part of the repository.
digest_recipe: sha256 over float64 little-endian bytes of numpy.stack([grid.real, grid.imag]) rounded to 10 decimals (+0.0 removes negative zeros); robust to one-ulp libm differences in the boost/de-boost amplitudes.
grid_layout: rows = 12*n_rb subcarriers from the lowest, columns = 14 OFDM symbols per slot, slots from 0
